name: master-run-command-center
description: Master-Run Command Center — Grok Computer pipeline console with full frontend deployment framework

scripts.check:html: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; t=Path('index.html').read_text(); assert '<!DOCTYPE html>' in t; assert 'data-tab=\"swarm\"' in t; assert 'data-tab=\"learning\"' in t; print('html ok', len(t))"
scripts.check:json: python3 -c "import json,pathlib; [json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in pathlib.Path('data').glob('*.json')]; print('json ok')"
scripts.audit: npm run check:html && npm run check:json && npm run check:headers
scripts.deploy:notes: echo 'Use: vercel --prod (requires VERCEL_TOKEN) or GitHub integration push to main'
